pick: one at random during setup, face down

cards.name: Rationing
cards.text: At the start of each Day, each house loses 1 credit (if it has any).

cards.name: Structural Fatigue
cards.text: Each cascade places 2 Decay in adjacent sections instead of 1 (players choose).

cards.name: Despair
cards.text: Each time Decay is placed, lose 1 Purpose.

cards.name: Failing Systems
cards.text: At each Grow, add 1 Glitch to every section with Decay that has no threat.
